title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and bump parity v1.77.0
author: Aisha Patel
description:
This PR consolidates recent ergonomics changes across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs: it unifies auth handling, standardizes retry backoff semantics, stabilizes streaming API ergonomics, and bumps SDK parity/version markers to v1.77.0. Motivation: multiple downstream customers reported inconsistent retry behavior and confusing streaming callback patterns across SDKs; this caused support overhead and small regressions in production. Changes include: 1) A common auth adapter pattern so token refresh and anonymous fallback behave similarly; 2) Standard retry policy implementation with configurable jitter and max-retries; 3) Streaming API surface unified to use a single high-level "StreamHandler" callback/async iterator pattern across languages; 4) Minor breaking-avoidant renames for ergonomics (deprecated helpers retained for one release); 5) Version bumps and changelogs for Python/TS/Go.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement common auth adapter across SDKs
- [x] Add deterministic retry policy with exponential backoff + jitter
- [x] Unify streaming ergonomics (callbacks + async iterators)
- [x] Add cross-language tests for parity
- [x] Update changelogs and bump versions to v1.77.0
- [x] Docs snippets updated

Commits (summary):
- feat(sdk): add auth adapter interface and default implementations (python/ts/go)
- feat(sdk): standardized retry policy (exponential+jitter) + config knobs
- feat(sdk): new StreamHandler abstraction and iterator support
- test(sdk): add cross-sdk parity tests for auth/retries/streaming
- chore: bump package versions to v1.77.0 and update changelogs
- fix: re-add deprecated helpers with warn() for one-release compatibility

- python/redwood_sdk/retries.py (policy + docs)
- typescript/src/auth/index.ts (adapter + TS types)
- typescript/src/streaming/streamHandler.ts (new API)
- go/sdk/auth/auth_adapter.go (adapter + docs)
- go/sdk/streaming/stream_handler.go (iterator + callback support)
- shared-tests/parity/auth_retries_streaming (integration harness)
- docs/sdk-auth-retries.md (illustrative examples)
